categoryCorrections.reason: The approved catalogue mapping assigns Granulator to the Mixing & Blending wave, so it is intentionally excluded here.
An oil expeller is a continuous mechanical extraction press, not a grinder.
An extruder is a continuous thermal and mechanical forming processor, not a grinder.
A centrifugal blower is general-purpose process air-moving equipment and is not itself a pollution-control collector.
